meta.name: Expiry Date Hindi
meta.description:
A married man discovers his wife cheating on him and accidentally kills her - what ensues is a series of unexpected plot twists.

Returning Series · First aired 2 Oct 2020 · India · Language: Hindi · 25 min
Studio: ZEE5 · Network: ZEE5

Complete series. On your server: S1 10/10

On your server — Audio: Hindi

videos.title: Surprise
videos.overview: A badly injured Vishwa is being chased by a car in a deserted area. As he collapses to the ground, he thinks about all that has happened to him over the last few months leading to this life-threatening situation.

videos.title: Imperfect Plan
videos.overview: Heartbroken Vishwa decides to take a drastic step instead of filing for divorce from Disha. However, suddenly his plans go awry, and Vishwa ends up committing a crime in a way he never anticipated putting himself in a precarious situation.

videos.title: Will Life Be Normal Again?
videos.overview: Against all odds, Vishwa buries his wife disguised as Sunny and is returning home when he sees Nisha, Disha's sister, guiding the police into his house.

videos.title: Double Jeopardy
videos.overview: Vishwa and Nisha lodge Disha's missing case complaint. Vishwa bumps into Sunitha, Sunny's wife, who surpisingly is there to lodge the excat same complaint for Sunny.

videos.title: Rest in Peace
videos.overview: Vishwa meets Sunitha to know the truth. When Sunitha reveals Sunny fate, Vishwa teams up with her to save himself.

videos.title: Backfire
videos.overview: Vishwa gets a call from an unkown number, who claims to know his secret. The caller's identity and his connection with Disha shocks Vishwa.

videos.title: Missing Link
videos.overview: Vishwa sets a trap for the blackmailer but his plan backfires when Sunita is unable to excute her task. Sunitha gets another call, this time from the police who have discovered something that can incriminate Vishwa and Sunitha.

videos.title: Closing In
videos.overview: The police interrogate Vishwa and blame him for the murder. He is set free after the watchman reveals that Vishwa never visited the place. Sunitha is now on the police's radar. Later, the police try to identify the blackmailer from Vishwa's phone record, but he escapes.

videos.title: Good Riddance
videos.overview: The blackmailer is killed in a scuffle with Vishwa. To confuse the police, Vishwa hits himself with a gunshot and acts like the blackmailer was appointed by Disha to kill Sunny. But do the police believe him?

videos.title: Karma Is A Bitch
videos.overview: Vishwa is kidnapped and tortured until he accepts that is he responsible for Disha's murder. Who is this person who forced a confession from Vishwa?
